title: Fixed-extent write beyond an automatic local array
claim_scope: Evidence Family match, not runtime exploitability
primary_discriminator: proven write extent > proven automatic-array capacity
known_limits: physical stack placement is not proven from LOCAL alone
symbolic or unknown write extent does not match this family
a different causal structure should be encoded as another family

machine_readable_semantics.match_requires: all required witness claims PROVEN and all blocking counter-evidence absent

cwe_mapping.rationale: The destination object must be proven to have automatic storage; a local/parameter stack object is the defining storage condition of CWE-121.
